reason.noCosts: Set up your costs to see the score

estimate.title: Estimated earnings
estimate.disclaimer: It's a suggestion, based on the rides the app saw you accept. The real amount may change with cancellations, tips, and fees. If needed, correct it when you log the shift.

screen.emptyMessage: Change the filters or wait for the next offers read by Copilot.
screen.autoRecord: The app automatically records what you accept. If the suggested amount differs from what you got paid, just correct it when you log the shift.
screen.estimatingHint: Notes when you tap accept or decline in ride-hailing apps. This stays on your phone.

clearConfirm.title: Clear offers?
clearConfirm.message: The history and the earnings estimate will be deleted. Saved shifts won't change.

hub.setupMessage: The Copilot reads Uber, 99 and inDrive offers and shows whether the ride pays off. Set it up in 2 steps.
hub.readingHint: Tap to adjust reading, card and voice

correct.title: Fix the result
correct.message: Mark what happened to this offer. This adjusts the estimated earnings.
correct.hint: Fixes whether the offer was accepted
